plugins.faceIDPermission: Mr. Valuator uses Face ID to let you sign in securely without typing your password each time.

plugins.motionPermission: Mr. Valuator uses device motion and compass heading to help you align north when marking property orientation during a valuation.

plugins.photosPermission: Mr. Valuator accesses your photo library so you can attach existing property photos to valuation reports.

plugins.cameraPermission: Mr. Valuator uses the camera to photograph properties for valuation reports (for example, site photos attached to an evaluation).
plugins.microphonePermission: Mr. Valuator may use the microphone when the camera captures media during a property site visit for a valuation report.
